items.source: Typically used to customize the configuration provided via @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker.
items.translation: 通常用于自定义通过 `@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker` 提供的配置。

items.source: This does not override the built-in support for resolving handler method arguments. To customize the built-in support for argument resolution, configure SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler directly.
items.translation: 这不会覆盖用于解析处理器方法参数的内置支持。若要自定义参数解析的内置支持，请直接配置 `SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler`。

items.source: Using this option does not override the built-in support for handling return values. To customize the built-in support for handling return values, configure SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler directly.
items.translation: 使用此选项不会覆盖内置的返回值处理支持。若要自定义内置的返回值处理支持，请直接配置 `SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler`。

items.source: The default implementation returns null which allows other configurers to decide. As soon as any configurer returns a value, that value is used. If no configurer returns a value, then 0 is used.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `null`，以便其他配置器自行决定。一旦有任何配置器返回值，即使用该值。如果没有任何配置器返回值，则使用 0。

items.source:
The provided list, initially empty, can be used to add message converters
while the boolean return value is used to determine if default message should
be added as well.
items.translation: 提供的列表初始为空，可用于添加消息转换器，而布尔返回值用于确定是否也要添加默认消息。

items.source:
It is recommended to use a phase value such as 0 in order to ensure that
components start before the web server in Spring Boot application.
items.translation: 建议使用诸如 0 这样的相位值，以确保在 Spring Boot 应用程序中组件在 Web 服务器之前启动。

items.source: Return the phase that WebSocket message handling beans of type SmartLifecycle should run in.
items.translation: 返回 WebSocket 消息处理 Bean（类型为SmartLifecycle）应运行的phase。

items.source: Configure the MessageChannel used for incoming messages from WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 配置用于接收来自 WebSocket 客户端的入站消息的MessageChannel。

items.source: Configure the MessageChannel used for outbound messages to WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 配置用于发往 WebSocket 客户端的出站消息的MessageChannel。

items.source: Configure the MessageChannel used for incoming messages from WebSocket clients. By default, the channel is backed by a thread pool of size 1. It is recommended to customize thread pool settings for production use.
items.translation: 配置用于接收来自 WebSocket 客户端的入站消息的MessageChannel。默认情况下，该通道由大小为 1 的线程池支持。建议为生产环境自定义线程池设置。

items.source: Configure the MessageChannel used for outbound messages to WebSocket clients. By default, the channel is backed by a thread pool of size 1. It is recommended to customize thread pool settings for production use.
items.translation: 配置用于发往 WebSocket 客户端的出站消息的MessageChannel。默认情况下，该通道由大小为 1 的线程池支持。建议为生产环境自定义线程池设置。

items.source: Configure message broker options.
items.translation: 配置消息代理选项。

items.source:
Configure options related to the processing of messages received from and
sent to WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 配置与接收自 WebSocket 客户端及发送至 WebSocket 客户端的消息处理相关的选项。

items.source:
Register STOMP endpoints mapping each to a specific URL and (optionally)
enabling and configuring SockJS fallback options.
items.translation: 注册 STOMP 端点，每个端点映射到特定的 URL，并（可选地）启用和配置 SockJS 回退选项。

items.source: argumentResolvers - the resolvers to register (initially an empty list)
items.translation: argumentResolvers - 要注册的解析器（初始为空列表）

items.source: returnValueHandlers - the handlers to register (initially an empty list)
items.translation: returnValueHandlers - 要注册的处理器（初始为空列表）

items.source: messageConverters - the converters to configure (initially an empty list)
items.translation: messageConverters - 要配置的转换器（初始为空列表）

items.source: whether to also add default converter or not
items.translation: 是否也要添加默认转换器

items.source: Add resolvers to support custom controller method argument types.
items.translation: 添加解析器以支持自定义控制器方法参数类型。

items.source: Add handlers to support custom controller method return value types.
items.translation: 添加处理器以支持自定义控制器方法返回值类型。

items.source:
Configure the message converters to use when extracting the payload of
messages in annotated methods and when sending messages (for example, through the
"broker" SimpMessagingTemplate).
items.translation: 配置在注解方法中提取消息负载以及发送消息（例如通过 "broker" SimpMessagingTemplate）时使用的消息转换器。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev
